gold_assessment.reasoning: Gold: 3‑day history of dry, itchy skin. Generated cc-001 and hpi-001 both describe dry, itchy/pruritic skin for a few days; duration wording is consistent (a few days ≈ 3 days).
Gold: mainly on arms, hands, and palms. Generated hpi-001: pruritus/redness mainly on arms and hands. Palms are part of hands and thus location is effectively captured.

Gold: rash has not spread elsewhere. Generated hpi-001 confines symptoms to arms and hands without mention of spread, and no other generated fact contradicts this. Location-only description implies no spread beyond those areas.
Gold: no bleeding, discharge, or cracked skin. None of the generated HPI or exam facts mention bleeding, discharge, or cracked skin.
Gold: symptoms started after swimming. Generated hpi-001: began a few days ago after swimming. Directly captured.
Gold: no previous history of skin problems. No generated fact comments on prior skin history.
Gold: denies fevers or vomiting. Generated hpi-003 (no fever) and hpi-007 (no vomiting) together cover this.
Gold: appetite maintained, lethargic. Generated hpi-005: mild fatigue, and hpi-006: eating/drinking/appetite normal. Fatigue ≈ lethargy and normal appetite matches 'appetite maintained'.

Gold: denies any bowel or urinary symptoms. Generated hpi-006: bowel habits normal; urinary not mentioned but no contradiction. Bowel portion is explicitly covered, urinary is omitted but not contradicted—overall intent (no bowel issues) is at least partially captured, and nothing opposes the gold fact.
Gold: history of lactose intolerance (PMH). Generated allergy-001: lactose intolerance listed under allergies/intolerances. Same condition, categorized differently but clinically equivalent.
Gold: takes Microgynon. Generated med-001: taking Microgynal contraceptive. Spelling variant but clearly the same medication/class.

Gold: no known drug allergies (NKDA). Generated allergy-001 assigns lactose intolerance as an allergy/intolerance. Lactose intolerance is a non–drug-related intolerance, so listing it as an allergy/intolerance contradicts the statement that there are no known drug allergies. At minimum, the gold explicitly says NKDA while the generated implies a clinically relevant allergy/intolerance entry.
Gold: father has asthma. Generated fh-001 states the same.
Gold: mother has hayfever. No generated fact mentions mother's hayfever.
Gold: lives alone and works as primary school teacher. Generated sh-001 (primary school teacher) and sh-002 (lives alone) together cover this.

Gold: denies smoking, alcohol, or recreational drugs. Generated sh-003 (non-smoker), sh-004 (minimal alcohol), and sh-005 (no recreational drugs). Alcohol use is stated as minimal rather than none but still aligns with 'denies etOH' in common documentation practice (no problematic use); not a direct contradiction.
Gold: significant recent stress. No generated fact mentions stress.
Gold: impression is dermatitis. Generated asm-001: acute pruritic, erythematous dermatitis of hands/arms with possible contact/irritant/eczema etiology. Clearly contains dermatitis impression.
Gold: steroid cream BD. Generated plan-002: recommend topical corticosteroid cream; frequency BD not specified, but use of steroid cream is captured.
Gold: advised to use emollients. Generated plan-001: recommend regular emollients applied liberally to affected areas. Directly matches.
Gold: advised antihistamines. Generated plan-003: recommend OTC oral antihistamine (piriton/loratadine) PRN. Matches and adds examples/dosing schedule.
Gold: review symptoms in one week. Generated fu-001: review in ~1 week if no improvement. Timing is equivalent.

Gold: seek earlier review for worsening symptoms or concerns. Generated fu-001: sooner if symptoms worsen or systemic symptoms develop. Worsening captured; systemic symptoms is a more specific form of 'any concerns'.

gen_assessment.reasoning: Dry, itchy skin for a few days matches 3‑day history of dry, itchy skin.
Pruritus correlates with itchy; location (arms/hands) and timing after swimming/for a few days match gold. Redness is an added detail but consistent with dermatitis.
No spots associated with symptoms is not mentioned in any gold fact; not contradictory, just extra negative detail.
No fever aligns with gold 'No fevers.'
Use of coconut butter without benefit is not present in gold facts and does not conflict with them.
Mild fatigue matches 'lethargic'.
Normal eating, drinking, appetite aligns with 'Appetite maintained.' Normal bowels also aligns with 'Nil bowel sx' in hpi-009.
No vomiting matches gold 'No vomiting.'
Generated: no past medical/surgical history. Gold: PMH includes lactose intolerance. Direct conflict regarding presence of a past medical condition.
Microgynal contraceptive corresponds to Microgynon in gold; spelling/brand variant only.
Generated lists lactose intolerance under allergies/intolerances. Gold: NKDA; lactose intolerance is in PMH, not allergy. This introduces an allergy/intolerance entry where gold indicates none.
Father with asthma matches gold.
Works as primary school teacher is part of gold social history (occupation).
Lives alone matches gold social history.
Non-smoker matches 'nil smoker'.

Minimal alcohol partially differs from 'nil etOH' in gold, but in many clinical contexts denotes no problematic or regular alcohol use; not a strict opposite, best categorized as an additional nuance that somewhat weakens the strict 'nil'.
No recreational drugs matches 'nil recreational drugs'.
Assessment of acute dermatitis of hands/arms with pruritus/erythema matches impression of dermatitis; added etiologic qualifiers are additional but consistent.
Mild fatigue in otherwise well patient aligns with lethargic but otherwise normal appetite and no systemic symptoms in gold.
Recommending regular emollients to affected areas matches gold advice to use emollients; application details are added.
Topical corticosteroid cream for inflamed areas matches steroid cream in plan; note BD frequency in gold is not specified in generated, but that's omission, not contradiction.
OTC oral antihistamine PRN for itch corresponds directly to advice to use antihistamines, with added drug examples and PRN schedule.
Advice about not relying on coconut butter and avoiding triggers (pool, harsh soaps) is not in gold; no conflicting gold plan details.
Stating analgesics not indicated is extra negative plan information not present in gold but not contradictory.
Providing an information leaflet about dermatitis is an added patient-education component absent from gold facts.
Review in about a week if no improvement matches review in 1 week; 'sooner if worsening/systemic symptoms' corresponds to earlier review for worsening/concerns (fu-002).

Skin exam description (reported erythema/pruritus on hands/arms) is extra detail; gold does not include physical findings, but this is clinically aligned with dermatitis and locations already described.
Statement that no vitals or formal exam are documented is not represented in gold facts and does not conflict with them.
